system.name: MetamerGen
system.one_liner: A latent diffusion model that turns fixated high-resolution glimpses plus a blurred peripheral gist into images that are metamers of what humans understood of a scene.

content.variant_note: inputs, frozen encoder, two query nets and a frozen UNet in a top row, with a wedge opening one UNet block into an enlarged panel below
content.argues: Two new conditioning streams, fixated high-resolution tokens and peripheral gist tokens, enter a frozen text-to-image UNet through added trainable cross-attention branches.
content.subject: High- and low-resolution photos, a frozen encoder with a fixation mask, two query nets, a pre-trained UNet and one enlarged block with text, fixation and peripheral cross-attention.

lessons.what_to_learn: To show where a new conditioning path joins a frozen backbone, draw the whole pipeline on top and open one block in a zoom panel, with parallel branches coloured per stream and a snowflake or flame on every module.
lessons.suits: Adapters or extra conditioning added to a pretrained diffusion or transformer backbone, where the reader must see what is new, what is frozen and where it joins.

evidence: Both foveal and peripheral patch tokens are processed through separate Perceiver-based query networks
The resulting dual conditioning streams are integrated into the pretrained UNet.

summary: MetamerGen is a latent diffusion model that generates image metamers of what humans understand after viewing a scene, combining a blurred peripheral gist with high-resolution information from fixated locations. Figure 1 shows the architecture. A high-resolution photo and its blurred copy pass through a frozen DINOv2 encoder; a fixation mask keeps only fixated high-res tokens, and two trainable Perceiver-style query nets compress fixation and peripheral features into conditioning tokens. These feed a frozen pre-trained text-to-image UNet, drawn as a grey hourglass between a noisy x_t and a cleaner x_t-1. A wedge opens one block: text, fixation and peripheral cross-attention run in parallel from a shared query, coloured green, red and blue, with snowflakes and flames marking frozen and trained parts.
summary_zh: MetamerGen是潜扩散模型，结合注视点高分辨率信息与模糊周边概要，生成与人类场景理解同色异谱的图像。图1上排为输入、编码器、查询网络和冻结UNet，下方放大一块：文本、注视、周边三路交叉注意力，雪花与火焰标冻结与训练。
notes: Single kind model-anatomy (the pre-screen agrees). About 96% of the canvas is covered by bitmaps, so much of the text is rasterised. The label ' ' tokens probably denotes an empty prompt. The eight UNet blocks carry coloured stripes that I read as the three stream colours; I did not verify this stripe by stripe. In the top row both streams are in the turquoise family, in the zoom panel red and blue.
